title: Where the Moon Hides Its Colour

content.question: At new moon, when the sky goes dark, is the moon's colour hiding somewhere I can find it, and does it sit in the same place each time?
content.method: Waited through dusk on the high rock, the warmest perch I could claim, with my eyes on the thin sliver of sky over the water. Kept the observation to a single steady watch, pretending I was not interested, and wrote down what I saw in the order I saw it, as a proper cat does.
content.result: The moon showed no colour I could name, only a pale edge where the dark ought to be. Whatever it hides, it does not hide it in the open. I have noted the place it did not appear and will watch the next new moon to see whether the hiding moves.
